Name: ConveyorBeltMod
Author: xc333222
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]Why choose us? Because our conveyor belts come with animations, item movement animations, and realistic mechanics.[/color][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54900/54900-1793519886-1376273718.jpg[/img]


This mod adds a brand new item—the conveyor belt.

It can be placed on the ground to connect a chest with a machine or other things.

Right-click to rotate the direction of the conveyor belt, and hold Shift to rotate the entire conveyor belt line.

After setting the direction, the chest will continuously send items onto the conveyor belt.

If you like this mod or want to report a bug, please take a look.
